Module com.mycompany.urbanlegends
Package game

Class MovementsLogic

java.lang.Object
game.MovementsLogic
public class MovementsLogic extends Object
MovementsLogic handles the logic for player movement and interaction with the game environment. It includes methods to validate movement directions, check proximity to NPCs, and detect blocked paths on the map.
Author:
jorge, joxan, melani, fabian, ismael

    • checkMovements

      public boolean checkMovements(String[][] map, Player player, String direction)
      This method checks if the player's movement in the specified direction is valid based on the current map and player's position
      Parameters:
      map - A 2D array representing the game map
      player - The player object with current position data
      direction - The direction in which the player wants to move ("up", "down", "right", "left").
      Returns:
      true if the movement is valid, false otherwise

    • isIsCloseToNpc

      public boolean isIsCloseToNpc()

      Returns:
      true if the player is near an NPC, false otherwise.

    • isNearLegend

      public boolean isNearLegend(String[][] map, int posX, int posY, char legendSymbol)
      Checks if the player is close to a specific legend on the map, such as "La Llorona" near a river. Verifies adjacent tiles around the player's position for the specified legend symbol.
      Parameters:
      map - A 2D array representing the game map
      posX - The player's current X-coordinate on the map
      posY - The player's current Y-coordinate on the map
      legendSymbol - The symbol character representing the legend on the map
      Returns:
      true if the player is near the specified legend; false otherwise
